# Wheel documentation

> Machine-readable documentation for the Wheel local-first Solid application framework.

Use `README.md` as the primary index. Source declarations and tests override prose when exact behavior matters.

## Start

- [Overview](overview.md): Ownership, data flow, layers, and conventions.
- [Getting started](getting-started.md): Repository setup and one feature's required files.
- [Project layout](project-layout.md): Directories, compiler settings, CSS, identity, and root mounts.
- [Walkthrough](walkthrough.md): Synced todo feature, file by file.
- [Upgrade from 0.1 to 0.2](upgrading.md): Breaking names, local data, protocol, and server changes.

## Application state and UI

- [State](state.md): Service primitives, query views, invalidation, and immutability.
- [Services](services.md): Dependency injection, lifecycle, time, and async flows.
- [Components](components.md): Connections, views, props, directives, and tests.
- [Component library](component-library.md): Component families, deep entries, selectors, and styles.
- [Debugging](debugging.md): Panel, bridge, driver, errors, snapshots, and component states.
- [Patterns](patterns.md): Global systems, isolation, and imperative runtime wrappers.
- [Routing](routing.md): Route trees, params, search, history, and errors.
- [Framing](framing.md): Resizable regions, persistence, docking, and gestures.

## Sync and data

- [Everyday data patterns](data-patterns.md): Query states, mutation feedback, and ordering.
- [Live state](live-state.md): Declarations, optimistic writes, offline replay, and provenance.
- [Server](server.md): Backends, SQL ownership, HTTP, and lifecycle.
- [Server handlers](server-advanced.md): Migrations, invalidation, ids, and external writes.
- [Derived collections](derived-collections.md): Derived row contracts and invalidation.
- [Presence](presence.md): Typed ephemeral peer state.
- [Undo and redo](undo.md): Inverse mutations and patch helpers.

## Operations and quality

- [Authentication](auth.md): Principals, authenticators, and authorization boundaries.
- [Configuration](configuration.md): JSON sources, precedence, and validation.
- [Cloudflare deployment](cloudflare.md): Branch Workers, hibernation, migrations, and deploy checks.
- [Production](production.md): Artifacts, process controls, base paths, and observability.
- [Testing](testing.md): Stubs, World, simulation, drivers, and browser behaviors.
- [Linting](linting.md): Complete rule catalog, scope, and limits.

## Reference

- [Real application](real-app.md): Tracker implementation reading order.
- [Architecture](architecture.md): Enforced dependency graph and locked engine decisions.
- [Import map](import-map.md): JavaScript, CSS, and tooling entries.
- [Swappable parts](advanced.md): Transport, cache, backend, driver, handler, and kit seams.
- [Names and errors](reference.md): Name grammar, JSON boundary, outcomes, and errors.
- [Public APIs](api/README.md): Generated export inventory with source links.
